meta.prompt: You are a meticulous QA test designer for an AI generation feature. Given the feature's capability surface, propose a se

scenarios.name: Circle with Chord and Diameter Labels
scenarios.constraint: Generate a circle with 4 named points on the circumference, two crossing chords between them, a labeled diameter, and a labeled central angle of 72°.
scenarios.rationale: Covers the broad circle capability surface: named circumference points, chords, diameter label, and central angle all exercised together — a standard breadth check for the circle renderer.

scenarios.name: Near-Degenerate Sliver Triangle with Long Side Labels
scenarios.constraint: Generate an SSS triangle with sides 0.05, 0.06, and 0.109 (nearly collinear) and label each side with a 28-character string like 'opposite-side-length-value-A'.
scenarios.rationale: Probes two known failure modes simultaneously: the near-degenerate sliver geometry collapses interior angles close to 0° and 180° (risking label-overlap and stroke-scaling breakdown), while the excessively long side labels stress-test clipping and layout on a figure with almost no interior space.

scenarios.name: Inconsistent SAS Triangle with False Right-Angle Mark
scenarios.constraint: Generate an SAS triangle with sides 3 and 4, included angle 90°, but also assert the third side is 6 (contradicting the Pythagorean result of 5) and render a right-angle mark at the included vertex.
scenarios.rationale: Directly targets the over-determined/inconsistent spec failure mode: the explicit hypotenuse (6) contradicts both the SAS-derived length (5) and the right-angle mark, forcing the renderer to reconcile or surface an error rather than silently produce a misleading diagram.
